# fct_via_supplier_returns

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_via_supplier_returns` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for suppliers surfaced by Via. Each row is one supplier returned by a single supplier_search, rates_summary, or rates_search tool-return message. Grain is one row per (message, supplier), so a single tool-return with multiple suppliers produces multiple rows.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `via_supplier_return_key` | Primary Key. Surrogate key hashed from message_id and supplier_id. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | The advisor ID associated with the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | The advisor UUID associated with the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `conversation_id` | Foreign Key. The Via conversation this supplier return belongs to. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | Timestamp when the tool-return message was created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_rates_returned` | True if this supplier came back with at least one bookable rate. Always false for supplier_search (never prices), always true for rates_summary (only returns suppliers it found a rate for), and varies for rates_search (can return a known supplier with zero available rates). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `message_id` | Foreign Key. The tool-return message (see fct_via_messages) this supplier was returned by. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `session_id` | Foreign Key. The Via session this supplier return belongs to. New sessions start after a 30+ minute gap in conversation activity. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_id` | The ID of the supplier returned. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `tool_name` | The tool that returned this supplier ('supplier_search', 'rates_summary', or 'rates_search'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
